name: BISHA
positioning: BISHA, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Toronto: a design-led hotel in the heart of the Entertainment District, with a rooftop infinity pool and suites envisioned by Lenny Kravitz
best_for: Design and art lovers who want a bold downtown base
Travelers who want a rooftop pool and skyline views in the Entertainment District

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Toronto's Entertainment District.
The lobby is done in black marble and draped velvet.
Public areas are adorned with pieces from the hotel's art collection, which includes a fair number of Warhol prints.
Rooms have custom-designed beds and marble bathrooms.
Mister C Lobby Bar has velvet walls and a circular fireplace.
The third-floor fitness facility includes steam rooms.

highlights.text: Some suites were envisioned by rocker and designer Lenny Kravitz.
The hotel has a rooftop infinity pool.
Some guest rooms have private terraces.
KOST is a rooftop restaurant with panoramic views of the city.
The hotel's staff, called Experience Producers, can suggest ways to explore the city.

considerations.text: The official rooms page lists no accessible rooms at this hotel.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may be noisy for light sleepers.
